CommunityApplications.Profile:
ticketarr is a headless service that watches an email inbox for AMC A-List and Regal Unlimited movie ticket confirmations, resolves each showing to a TMDB id, and reports the watch to your tracker of choice (Trakt, Ryot, or Yamtrack) with the correct timestamp. It can also request the movie in Jellyseerr/Overseerr or Ombi so it's ready to stream by the time you get home from the theater.
There is no web UI - the container only exposes a private `/healthz` port for Docker healthchecks. All configuration lives in `/config/config.yml` (or environment variables). See the project page for the full setup guide.
Support: GitHub Issues on the project repo below.
